tools.name: vendor_brief
tools.description: Open one NODEAPI work item and return its neutral platform source metadata. Call once before vendor_pull.

tools.name: vendor_pull
tools.description: Fetch one NODEAPI response exactly as captured by the platform. The raw payload is enclosed by item-bound boundary lines carrying its UTF-8 octet count and SHA-256 digest. Call once after vendor_brief.

tools.name: vendor_submit
tools.description: Submit the exact verify value observed in one pulled response. A correct value returns that item's signed receipt.
